source.text: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע־נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל־דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And but hear, please, Job, my speech, and all my words give ear [to].

en.L: But now, please hear my speech, Job, \q and give ear to all my words.
en.B: But now, Job, please listen to what I say; \q pay attention to all my words.
en.R: Now, Job, please listen to what I say. \q Pay attention to everything I tell you.

es.L: Pero ahora, oye, te ruego, mi discurso, Job, \q y presta oído a todas mis palabras.
es.B: Pero ahora, Job, te ruego que escuches lo que digo; \q atiende a todas mis palabras.
es.R: Ahora, Job, escucha lo que digo, por favor. \q Pon atención a todo lo que te voy a decir.

fr.L: Mais maintenant, écoute donc mon discours, Job, \q et prête l’oreille à toutes mes paroles.
fr.B: Mais maintenant, Job, écoute, je te prie, ce que je dis ; \q sois attentif à toutes mes paroles.
fr.R: Maintenant, Job, écoute ce que je dis, s’il te plaît. \q Fais attention à tout ce que je te dis.

sw.L: Lakini sasa, tafadhali, sikia maneno yangu, Ayubu, \q na uyategee sikio maneno yangu yote.
sw.B: Lakini sasa, Ayubu, tafadhali sikiliza ninachosema; \q yazingatie maneno yangu yote.
sw.R: Sasa, Ayubu, tafadhali sikiliza ninachosema. \q Sikiliza kwa makini yote ninayokuambia.

vi.L: Nhưng bây giờ, xin ông hãy nghe lời tôi nói, hỡi ông Gióp, \q và lắng tai nghe mọi lời của tôi.
vi.B: Nhưng bây giờ, thưa ông Gióp, xin ông nghe tôi nói; \q xin để tâm đến mọi lời của tôi.
vi.R: Bây giờ, thưa ông Gióp, xin ông nghe tôi nói. \q Xin ông chú ý mọi điều tôi sẽ nói với ông.

ko.L: 그러나 이제, 욥 어른, 부디 내 말을 들으시오. \q 내 모든 말에 귀를 기울이시오.
ko.B: 그러니 이제 욥 어른, 부디 내가 하는 말을 들어 보시오. \q 내 모든 말에 귀를 기울이시오.
ko.R: 이제 욥 어른, 내 말을 좀 들어 보시오. \q 내가 하는 말을 모두 잘 들으시오.

decisions.choice: Job: Elihu addresses Job by name
decisions.reason: Elihu turns from the friends (32:6-22) to Job himself, and calls him by name, as he does again in 33:31 and 37:14. The three friends never address Job by name in their speeches.

decisions.choice: but now: a turn to a new address
decisions.reason: The word ('ulam) marks a strong contrast or a new start: having explained himself to the friends, Elihu now speaks to Job.

decisions.choice: pay attention to (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Give ear" is the Hebrew picture of listening; Literal keeps it, Balanced and Readable use the everyday phrase.

decisions.choice: Elihu calls Job "ông" ("thưa ông Gióp" at Balanced and Readable) and himself "tôi"
decisions.reason: Elihu is much younger than Job (32:6), so he addresses him as an elder with "ông", even while correcting him; the three friends, his equals, say "anh".

decisions.choice: Elihu speaks to Job in 하오체 (-시오, -소, -오) and calls him "욥 어른" and "그대", himself "나"; descriptive lines inside his speech (about God, about himself, about people in general) are in plain 해라체, and Job's words as Elihu quotes them are plain style
alternatives: 합쇼체 to Job, as Elihu speaks to the three elders
decisions.reason: Elihu is the youngest (32:6) but now argues with Job as an equal in debate, so he uses the 하오체 the friends use with Job, softened by the respectful 어른. As in the rest of Job, 하오체 is kept to the lines addressed to the listener; the general statements are in the plain style of Korean poetry.

source.text: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, please, I open my mouth; speaks my tongue in my palate.

en.L: Look, now, I open my mouth; \q my tongue speaks in my palate.
en.B: Look, I have opened my mouth; \q my tongue is forming words in my mouth.
en.R: I am ready to speak. \q The words are on the tip of my tongue.

es.L: Mira, ahora abro mi boca; \q mi lengua habla en mi paladar.
es.B: Mira, he abierto mi boca; \q mi lengua va formando las palabras en mi boca.
es.R: Estoy listo para hablar. \q Las palabras ya me salen de la boca.

fr.L: Voici, j’ouvre donc ma bouche ; \q ma langue parle dans mon palais.
fr.B: Voici, j’ai ouvert la bouche ; \q ma langue forme les mots dans ma bouche.
fr.R: Je suis prêt à parler. \q Les mots se pressent sur mes lèvres.

sw.L: Tazama, sasa nafungua kinywa changu; \q ulimi wangu unanena katika kaakaa langu.
sw.B: Tazama, nimefungua kinywa changu; \q ulimi wangu unatamka maneno kinywani mwangu.
sw.R: Niko tayari kusema. \q Maneno yamo tayari kinywani mwangu.

vi.L: Kìa, nay tôi mở miệng; \q lưỡi tôi nói trong vòm miệng tôi.
vi.B: Này, tôi đã mở miệng; \q lưỡi tôi đang uốn thành lời trong miệng tôi.
vi.R: Tôi sẵn sàng nói rồi. \q Lời đã sẵn trên đầu lưỡi tôi.

ko.L: 보시오, 이제 내가 입을 여니 \q 내 혀가 내 입천장에서 말을 하오.
ko.B: 보시오, 내가 입을 열었으니 \q 내 혀가 입 안에서 말을 짓고 있소.
ko.R: 나는 말할 준비가 되었소. \q 할 말이 혀끝까지 나와 있소.

decisions.choice: open my mouth, my tongue speaks in my palate: I am about to speak
decisions.reason: To open the mouth is to begin to speak (3:1). The palate or roof of the mouth is where words are shaped (6:30; Proverbs 8:7). Elihu announces at length, almost solemnly, that he is ready to begin.

decisions.choice: I am ready to speak; on the tip of my tongue (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pictures mean in common English idiom (m1).

decisions.choice: "Las palabras ya me salen de la boca" (Readable)
alternatives: "Tengo las palabras en la punta de la lengua"
decisions.reason: The Spanish idiom "en la punta de la lengua" means a word one cannot quite recall, the opposite of Elihu's readiness; the Readable says he is about to speak.

decisions.choice: « Les mots se pressent sur mes lèvres » (Readable)
alternatives: « J'ai les mots sur le bout de la langue »
decisions.reason: « Avoir sur le bout de la langue » means failing to recall a word, the opposite of what Elihu says; the Readable keeps his eagerness to speak.

source.text: יֹֽשֶׁר־לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] uprightness of my heart [are] my words, and [the] knowledge of my lips purely they utter.

en.L: My words [are from the] uprightness of my heart, \q and what my lips know they utter purely.
en.B: My words come from an upright heart, \q and my lips speak what I know sincerely.
en.R: I speak honestly, from my heart. \q I will tell you sincerely what I know.

es.L: Mis palabras [salen de] la rectitud de mi corazón, \q y lo que mis labios saben lo dicen con pureza.
es.B: Mis palabras salen de un corazón recto, \q y mis labios dicen con sinceridad lo que sé.
es.R: Hablo con honradez, de corazón. \q Te diré con sinceridad lo que sé.

fr.L: Mes paroles [viennent de] la droiture de mon cœur, \q et ce que mes lèvres savent, elles le disent avec pureté.
fr.B: Mes paroles viennent d’un cœur droit, \q et mes lèvres disent avec sincérité ce que je sais.
fr.R: Je parle avec franchise, du fond du cœur. \q Je te dirai sincèrement ce que je sais.

sw.L: Maneno yangu [ni ya] unyofu wa moyo wangu, \q na kile midomo yangu ikijuacho inakitamka kwa usafi.
sw.B: Maneno yangu yanatoka katika moyo mnyofu, \q na midomo yangu inasema kwa unyofu kile ninachokijua.
sw.R: Nasema kwa uaminifu, kutoka moyoni. \q Nitakuambia kwa moyo safi kile ninachokijua.

vi.L: Lời tôi [phát ra từ] sự ngay thẳng của lòng tôi, \q và điều môi tôi biết, môi tôi nói ra cách tinh sạch.
vi.B: Lời tôi xuất phát từ tấm lòng ngay thẳng, \q và môi tôi chân thành nói ra điều tôi biết.
vi.R: Tôi nói thật lòng mình. \q Tôi sẽ thành thật nói với ông điều tôi biết.

ko.L: 내 말은 내 마음의 정직함[에서 나오고], \q 내 입술이 아는 것을 순전하게 말하오.
ko.B: 내 말은 정직한 마음에서 나오고, \q 내 입술은 내가 아는 것을 진실하게 말하오.
ko.R: 나는 진심으로 정직하게 말하오. \q 내가 아는 것을 그대에게 거짓 없이 말하겠소.

decisions.choice: uprightness: honesty, straightness
decisions.reason: The word (yosher) comes from the same root as "upright" in 1:1. Elihu claims that his words come from an honest heart, with no hidden aim.

decisions.choice: purely: clearly, sincerely
decisions.reason: The word (barur) means clean, pure, picked out (Zephaniah 3:9, "pure lips"). What Elihu knows, he will say plainly and without mixture.

decisions.choice: I speak honestly, from my heart (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable turns the noun phrase "the uprightness of my heart" into a short sentence.

source.text: רֽוּחַ־אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] spirit of God has made me, and [the] breath of [the] Almighty gives me life.

en.L: The Spirit of God has made me, \q and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
en.B: The Spirit of God has made me; \q the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
en.R: God's Spirit made me. \q The breath of God All-Powerful gives me life.

es.L: El Espíritu de Dios me ha hecho, \q y el aliento del Todopoderoso me da vida.
es.B: El Espíritu de Dios me formó; \q el aliento del Todopoderoso me mantiene con vida.
es.R: El Espíritu de Dios me creó. \q El aliento del Dios Todopoderoso me da vida.

fr.L: L’Esprit de Dieu m’a fait, \q et le souffle du Tout-Puissant me donne la vie.
fr.B: C’est l’Esprit de Dieu qui m’a fait ; \q le souffle du Tout-Puissant me fait vivre.
fr.R: L’Esprit de Dieu m’a créé. \q Le souffle de Dieu le Tout-Puissant me donne la vie.

sw.L: Roho wa Mungu ameniumba, \q na pumzi ya Mwenyezi hunipa uhai.
sw.B: Roho wa Mungu ndiye aliyeniumba; \q pumzi ya Mwenyezi hunipa uzima.
sw.R: Roho wa Mungu aliniumba. \q Pumzi ya Mungu Mwenyezi hunipa uhai.

vi.L: Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời đã dựng nên tôi, \q và hơi thở của Đấng Toàn Năng ban sự sống cho tôi.
vi.B: Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời đã tạo nên tôi; \q hơi thở của Đấng Toàn Năng cho tôi được sống.
vi.R: Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời đã tạo ra tôi. \q Hơi thở của Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng cho tôi sự sống.

ko.L: 하나님의 영이 나를 지으셨고 \q 전능자의 숨결이 나를 살게 하신다.
ko.B: 하나님의 영께서 나를 만드셨고, \q 전능자의 숨결이 내게 생명을 주신다.
ko.R: 하나님의 영께서 나를 만드셨다. \q 전능하신 하나님의 숨결이 나에게 생명을 주신다.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of God: God's own life-giving spirit, his breath
decisions.reason: The word (ruach) means wind, breath or spirit. Here it is God's own, and it stands beside "the breath of the Almighty": God made the first human from dust and breathed into him the breath of life (Genesis 2:7), and his spirit gives and sustains all life (Psalm 104:30; Job 27:3; 34:14-15). Elihu says that he, like Job, is God's creature (verse 6), and that his understanding comes from the same breath of God (32:8).

decisions.choice: the Almighty: Shaddai
decisions.reason: Shaddai, an ancient name of God, is rendered "the Almighty" (see 5:17).

decisions.choice: Spirit, with a capital S
decisions.reason: The spirit here belongs to God, as in "the Spirit of God" in Genesis 1:2, so it is capitalized, as the Spirit of the LORD is in Judges. In 32:8, where the spirit is spoken of as it is in a human being, it is lowercase. "Breath" is kept for the parallel word in the second line.

decisions.choice: God All-Powerful (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "God All-Powerful" for Shaddai in every book.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời", with "hơi thở" for the parallel word
alternatives: "hơi thở của Đức Chúa Trời" in both lines
decisions.reason: The spirit here is God's own, as in Genesis 1:2, where the published Vietnamese has "Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời"; "hơi thở" keeps the picture of God breathing life into the first human (Genesis 2:7).

source.text: אִם־תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃

records.literal_gloss: If you are able, answer me; set in order before me; take your stand.

en.L: If you can, answer me; \q set [your case] in order before me; \q take your stand.
en.B: Answer me if you can; \q prepare your case before me \q and take your stand.
en.R: Answer me if you can. \q Get your arguments ready \q and stand up to me.

es.L: Si puedes, respóndeme; \q pon [tu causa] en orden delante de mí; \q mantente firme.
es.B: Respóndeme si puedes; \q prepara tu causa delante de mí \q y mantente firme.
es.R: Respóndeme si puedes. \q Prepara tus argumentos \q y hazme frente.

fr.L: Si tu le peux, réponds-moi ; \q mets [ta cause] en ordre devant moi ; \q tiens-toi debout.
fr.B: Réponds-moi si tu le peux ; \q prépare ta cause devant moi \q et tiens bon.
fr.R: Réponds-moi si tu peux. \q Prépare tes arguments \q et tiens-moi tête.

sw.L: Ukiweza, unijibu; \q panga [hoja zako] mbele yangu; \q simama imara.
sw.B: Nijibu kama unaweza; \q andaa kesi yako mbele yangu \q na usimame imara.
sw.R: Nijibu kama unaweza. \q Andaa hoja zako \q na usimame kunikabili.

vi.L: Nếu ông có thể, hãy đáp lại tôi; \q hãy sắp đặt [lý lẽ] trước mặt tôi; \q hãy đứng vững.
vi.B: Nếu ông có thể thì hãy trả lời tôi; \q hãy chuẩn bị lý lẽ của ông trước mặt tôi \q và đứng vững.
vi.R: Nếu được thì ông hãy trả lời tôi. \q Ông hãy chuẩn bị lý lẽ \q và đứng lên đối đáp với tôi.

ko.L: 할 수 있거든 내게 대답하시오. \q 내 앞에 [그대의 변론을] 늘어놓으시오. \q 굳게 서시오.
ko.B: 할 수 있다면 내게 대답하시오. \q 내 앞에서 그대의 변론을 준비하고 \q 굳게 서시오.
ko.R: 할 수 있으면 내게 대답해 보시오. \q 그대의 주장을 준비하고 \q 나와 맞서 보시오.

decisions.choice: set in order: arrange your case
decisions.reason: The verb ('arakh) is used for laying out a legal case (13:18; 23:4) and for drawing up a battle line. Job had said he would set out his case before God (23:4); Elihu invites him to set it out before him.

decisions.choice: take your stand: stand firm, as in court or battle
decisions.reason: The verb (yatsav in the reflexive) means to take up one's position and stand ready (1 Samuel 17:16; Psalm 2:2).

decisions.choice: your case (Literal, Balanced); your arguments (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb has no object in Hebrew; the context of argument supplies it (m1).

source.text: הֵן־אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם־אָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] like your mouth to God; from clay was pinched off also I.

en.L: Look, I [am] as you [are] before God; \q I too was pinched off from clay.
en.B: Look, before God I am just as you are; \q I too was shaped from clay.
en.R: You and I are the same in God's eyes. \q I too was made from clay.

es.L: Mira, yo [soy] como tú ante Dios; \q también yo fui desprendido del barro.
es.B: Mira, delante de Dios soy igual que tú; \q también yo fui formado del barro.
es.R: Tú y yo somos iguales ante Dios. \q A mí también me hizo del barro.

fr.L: Voici, je [suis] comme toi devant Dieu ; \q moi aussi, j’ai été détaché de l’argile.
fr.B: Voici, devant Dieu je suis tout comme toi ; \q moi aussi, j’ai été façonné dans l’argile.
fr.R: Toi et moi, nous sommes pareils aux yeux de Dieu. \q Moi aussi, j’ai été fait d’argile.

sw.L: Tazama, mimi [ni] kama wewe mbele ya Mungu; \q mimi pia nilimegwa kutoka kwenye udongo.
sw.B: Tazama, mbele ya Mungu mimi ni sawa nawe; \q mimi pia nilifinyangwa kwa udongo.
sw.R: Mimi na wewe tu sawa mbele ya Mungu. \q Mimi pia niliumbwa kwa udongo.

vi.L: Kìa, tôi [cũng] như ông trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời; \q tôi cũng được ngắt ra từ đất sét.
vi.B: Này, trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời tôi cũng như ông; \q tôi cũng được nắn nên từ đất sét.
vi.R: Trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, ông và tôi đều như nhau. \q Tôi cũng được làm ra từ đất sét.

ko.L: 보시오, 나도 하나님 앞에서 그대와 같소. \q 나 또한 진흙에서 떼어 내어졌소.
ko.B: 보시오, 하나님 앞에서 나도 그대와 다를 것이 없소. \q 나 또한 진흙으로 빚어졌소.
ko.R: 하나님께서 보시기에 그대와 나는 같소. \q 나도 진흙으로 만들어졌소.

decisions.choice: like your mouth to God: just as you are before God
alternatives: as you asked, I stand in God's place
decisions.reason: "Like your mouth" means "like you", "equal to you" (as "according to the mouth" can mean "in proportion to"). Elihu says he stands before God on the same footing as Job. The phrase can also mean "according to your word": Job had asked to argue with someone who would not overwhelm him (9:34-35; 13:21), and Elihu offers to be that one.

decisions.choice: pinched off from clay: shaped by God like a potter's work
decisions.reason: A potter nips off a piece of clay to shape a vessel. Humans are made from the ground (Genesis 2:7), and Job himself said God had shaped him like clay (10:9; see 4:19). The verb (qarats) is used for pinching or nipping.

decisions.choice: shaped (Balanced); made (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the potter's action; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m2).

decisions.choice: "nilimegwa" (Literal), "nilifinyangwa" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Kumega" is to break off a piece, the potter's nipping off of clay that Literal keeps; "kufinyanga" is the potter's shaping of it, which Balanced says.

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, dread of me not will terrify you, and my pressure on you not will be heavy.

en.L: Look, dread of me will not terrify you, \q and my pressure will not be heavy on you.
en.B: So no fear of me need terrify you, \q and my pressure will not weigh heavily on you.
en.R: You do not need to be afraid of me. \q I will not be hard on you.

es.L: Mira, el terror de mí no te espantará, \q y mi presión no será pesada sobre ti.
es.B: Así que ningún temor de mí tiene por qué espantarte, \q y mi presión no pesará sobre ti.
es.R: No tienes por qué tenerme miedo. \q No seré duro contigo.

fr.L: Voici, la terreur de moi ne t’épouvantera pas, \q et ma pression ne sera pas lourde sur toi.
fr.B: Ainsi, nulle crainte de moi ne doit t’épouvanter, \q et ma pression ne pèsera pas lourdement sur toi.
fr.R: Tu n’as pas besoin d’avoir peur de moi. \q Je ne serai pas dur avec toi.

sw.L: Tazama, hofu yangu haitakutisha, \q wala shinikizo langu halitakulemea.
sw.B: Basi hofu yangu haipaswi kukutisha, \q wala shinikizo langu halitakulemea.
sw.R: Huna sababu ya kuniogopa. \q Sitakuwa mkali kwako.

vi.L: Kìa, sự kinh hãi về tôi sẽ không làm ông khiếp sợ, \q và sức ép của tôi sẽ không đè nặng trên ông.
vi.B: Vậy, ông chẳng cần phải kinh sợ tôi, \q và sức ép của tôi sẽ không đè nặng trên ông.
vi.R: Ông không cần phải sợ tôi. \q Tôi sẽ không khắt khe với ông.

ko.L: 보시오, 나에 대한 두려움이 그대를 놀라게 하지 않을 것이고, \q 내 압박이 그대에게 무겁지 않을 것이오.
ko.B: 그러니 그대는 나를 두려워하여 놀랄 필요가 없소. \q 내가 그대를 무겁게 누르지 않을 것이오.
ko.R: 나를 무서워할 필요가 없소. \q 나는 그대를 몰아붙이지 않겠소.

decisions.choice: dread of me will not terrify you: an echo of Job's words
decisions.reason: Job had asked God to take away his hand and not let dread of him terrify him, so that he could speak (9:34; 13:21). Elihu takes up the same words: as a fellow creature, he will not overwhelm Job.

decisions.choice: my pressure: my weight upon you
decisions.reason: The word ('ekhef) occurs only here; it seems to mean pressure or burden, from a root meaning to press. The ancient Greek translation reads "my hand", which fits Job's words in 13:21, "take your hand far from me".

decisions.choice: So (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Look" here draws a conclusion from verse 6; Balanced says "So", and Readable leaves the word out.

source.text: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely you have spoken in my ears, and [the] sound of words I heard.

en.L: Surely you have spoken in my ears, \q and I heard the sound of [your] words:
en.B: You have surely spoken in my hearing, \q and I have heard the sound of your words:
en.R: I have heard what you said; \q I heard your words with my own ears:

es.L: Ciertamente tú has hablado a mis oídos, \q y oí el sonido de [tus] palabras:
es.B: Es verdad que has hablado a mis oídos, \q y he oído el sonido de tus palabras:
es.R: He oído lo que dijiste; \q oí tus palabras con mis propios oídos:

fr.L: Assurément, tu as parlé à mes oreilles, \q et j’ai entendu le son de [tes] paroles :
fr.B: Oui, tu as parlé devant moi, \q et j’ai entendu le son de tes paroles :
fr.R: J’ai entendu ce que tu as dit ; \q j’ai entendu tes paroles de mes propres oreilles :

sw.L: Hakika umenena masikioni mwangu, \q nami nimesikia sauti ya maneno [yako]:
sw.B: Kweli umesema nikisikia, \q nami nimeisikia sauti ya maneno yako:
sw.R: Nimesikia ulichosema; \q nimeyasikia maneno yako kwa masikio yangu mwenyewe:

vi.L: Thật, ông đã nói vào tai tôi, \q và tôi đã nghe tiếng của lời [ông]:
vi.B: Quả thật ông đã nói cho tôi nghe, \q và tôi đã nghe tiếng lời ông:
vi.R: Tôi đã nghe ông nói; \q chính tai tôi đã nghe những lời ông:

ko.L: 참으로 그대는 내 귀에 말했고, \q 나는 [그대의] 말소리를 들었소.
ko.B: 그대가 내 귀에 분명히 말했고, \q 나는 그대의 말소리를 들었소.
ko.R: 나는 그대가 한 말을 들었소. \q 그대의 말을 내 귀로 똑똑히 들었소.

decisions.choice: you have spoken: Elihu begins to sum up Job's words (verses 9-11)
decisions.reason: Elihu now quotes, in his own summary, what Job has claimed, before answering it in verse 12. Hebrew has no quotation marks; the colon at the end of the verse introduces the words.

decisions.choice: your words
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "words"; the context makes clear they are Job's, which Literal brackets.

source.text: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Pure I [am], without transgression; clean I [am], and not iniquity [is] to me.

en.L: I [am] pure, without transgression; \q I [am] clean, \q and there [is] no iniquity in me.
en.B: I am pure, without transgression; \q I am clean, \q and there is no guilt in me.
en.R: I am pure and have done nothing wrong. \q I am clean; there is no sin in me.

es.L: Puro [soy] yo, sin transgresión; \q limpio [soy] yo, \q y no [hay] iniquidad en mí.
es.B: Soy puro, sin transgresión; \q estoy limpio, \q y no hay culpa en mí.
es.R: Soy puro y no he hecho nada malo. \q Estoy limpio; no hay pecado en mí.

fr.L: Je [suis] pur, sans transgression ; \q je [suis] net, \q et il n’y a pas d’iniquité en moi.
fr.B: Je suis pur, sans transgression ; \q je suis net, \q et il n’y a pas de faute en moi.
fr.R: Je suis pur et je n’ai rien fait de mal. \q Je suis net ; il n’y a pas de péché en moi.

sw.L: Mimi [ni] safi, bila kosa; \q mimi [sina] doa, \q wala hakuna uovu ndani yangu.
sw.B: Mimi ni safi, sina kosa; \q mimi sina doa, \q wala hakuna hatia ndani yangu.
sw.R: Mimi ni safi, sijatenda kosa lolote. \q Sina doa; hakuna dhambi ndani yangu.

vi.L: Tôi tinh sạch, không có sự vi phạm; \q tôi trong sạch, \q và không có tội ác nơi tôi.
vi.B: Tôi tinh sạch, không vi phạm điều gì; \q tôi trong sạch, \q và không có tội lỗi nơi tôi.
vi.R: Tôi trong sạch và không làm gì sai. \q Tôi trong trắng; trong tôi không có tội gì.

ko.L: 나는 깨끗하여 허물이 없다. \q 나는 정결하니 \q 내게는 죄악이 없다.
ko.B: 나는 깨끗하고 허물이 없다. \q 나는 정결하니 \q 내게는 잘못이 없다.
ko.R: 나는 깨끗하고 잘못한 것이 없다. \q 나는 정결하다. 내게는 죄가 없다.

decisions.choice: Elihu's summary of Job's claims, not an exact quotation
decisions.reason: Job had insisted on his innocence (9:21; 10:7; 16:17; 23:10-12; 27:5-6; chapter 31), but he never said that he was without any sin: he spoke of the sins of his youth (13:26) and asked why God did not pardon his wrongdoing (7:21). Elihu sharpens Job's words into a claim of complete purity.

decisions.choice: clean: washed clean
decisions.reason: The word (chaf) occurs only here; it is related to a verb for washing or rubbing clean. It stands beside "pure" (zakh, 8:6; 11:4).

decisions.choice: guilt (Balanced); sin (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word ('avon) means wrongdoing and the guilt it brings; Literal keeps the traditional "iniquity".

decisions.choice: Job's words as Elihu sums them up (verses 9-11) in the plain style (-다), with 그분 and -시- for God
alternatives: 하오체, as if Elihu still spoke to Job
decisions.reason: Elihu gives Job's claims in Job's own voice, without quotation marks, as the English does; the plain style marks them off from Elihu's 하오체 address before and after.

source.text: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, occasions against me he finds; he counts me as an enemy to him.

en.L: Look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} finds pretexts against me; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} counts me as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemy.
en.B: Yet God finds reasons to oppose me; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} counts me as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemy.
en.R: But God looks for reasons to attack me. \q He treats me as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemy.

es.L: Mira, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} halla pretextos contra mí; \q me tiene por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enemigo.
es.B: Pero Dios busca motivos para oponerse a mí; \q me considera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enemigo.
es.R: Pero Dios busca razones para atacarme. \q Me trata como a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enemigo.

fr.L: Voici, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} trouve des prétextes contre moi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me compte pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ennemi.
fr.B: Pourtant Dieu trouve des raisons de s’opposer à moi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me tient pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ennemi.
fr.R: Mais Dieu cherche des raisons de m’attaquer. \q Il me traite comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ennemi.

sw.L: Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hupata visingizio dhidi yangu; \q hunihesabu kuwa adui {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Lakini Mungu hutafuta sababu za kunipinga; \q hunihesabu kuwa adui {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu anatafuta sababu za kunishambulia. \q Ananitendea kama adui {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tìm cớ nghịch lại tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kể tôi là kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Thế mà Đức Chúa Trời tìm cớ chống lại tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} coi tôi như kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời tìm cớ để tấn công tôi. \q Ngài đối xử với tôi như kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 보라, 그분이 나를 칠 구실을 찾으시고 \q 나를 그분의 원수로 여기신다.
ko.B: 그런데 하나님께서 나를 대적할 이유를 찾으시고 \q 나를 그분의 원수로 여기신다.
ko.R: 그런데 하나님께서는 나를 칠 이유를 찾으신다. \q 그분은 나를 원수처럼 대하신다.

decisions.choice: pretexts: occasions for hostility, excuses to oppose
decisions.reason: The word (tenu'ot) is rare; in Numbers 14:34 it means God's opposition or turning against Israel. Here it means grounds God seeks for treating Job as an opponent.

decisions.choice: counts me as his enemy: Job's own words
decisions.reason: Job asked God why he counted him as his enemy (13:24) and said that God counted him among his foes (19:11). Elihu quotes him almost word for word.

decisions.choice: God (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Job is speaking of God; Balanced and Readable name him the first time so that "he" is clear.

source.text: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: He puts in the stocks my feet; he watches all my paths.

en.L: He puts my feet in the stocks; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} watches all my paths.
en.B: He puts my feet in the stocks; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} watches all my paths.
en.R: He locks my feet in the stocks \q and watches every step I take.

es.L: Pone mis pies en el cepo; \q vigila todas mis sendas.
es.B: Pone mis pies en el cepo; \q vigila todos mis caminos.
es.R: Me sujeta los pies en el cepo \q y vigila cada paso que doy.

fr.L: Il met mes pieds dans les ceps ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} surveille tous mes sentiers.
fr.B: Il met mes pieds dans les entraves ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} surveille tous mes chemins.
fr.R: Il m’attache les pieds dans les entraves \q et surveille chacun de mes pas.

sw.L: Huitia miguu yangu katika mkatale; \q huzichunguza njia zangu zote.
sw.B: Huiweka miguu yangu katika mkatale; \q huziangalia njia zangu zote.
sw.R: Anaifunga miguu yangu katika mkatale \q na kuchunguza kila hatua ninayopiga.

vi.L: Ngài đặt chân tôi vào cùm; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} canh chừng mọi nẻo đường tôi.
vi.B: Ngài cùm chân tôi lại; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} theo dõi mọi đường lối tôi.
vi.R: Ngài cùm chặt chân tôi \q và theo dõi từng bước tôi đi.

ko.L: 그분이 내 발을 차꼬에 채우시고 \q 내 모든 길을 지켜보신다.
ko.B: 그분이 내 발에 차꼬를 채우시고 \q 내 모든 길을 감시하신다.
ko.R: 그분이 내 발을 차꼬에 꽉 채우시고 \q 내가 내딛는 걸음마다 지켜보신다.

decisions.choice: a quotation of Job's words in 13:27
decisions.reason: Job said: "You put my feet in the stocks and watch all my paths" (13:27). Elihu repeats the line, turned into the third person.

decisions.choice: the stocks: a wooden frame holding a prisoner's feet
decisions.reason: The stocks held a prisoner's feet fast so that he could not move (Jeremiah 20:2; Acts 16:24). Job pictures himself as God's prisoner, watched at every step.

decisions.choice: every step I take (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "paths" stands for: every step of Job's life.

source.text: הֶן־זֹ֣את לֹא־צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, [in] this not you are right, I will answer you, for is greater God than a mortal.

en.L: Look, [in] this you are not right, I will answer you, \q for God is greater than a mortal.
en.B: But in this you are not right, I tell you, \q for God is greater than any human.
en.R: But I tell you, you are wrong about this, \q because God is greater than any human being.

es.L: Mira, [en] esto no tienes razón, te responderé, \q porque Dios es más grande que un mortal.
es.B: Pero en esto no tienes razón, te lo digo, \q porque Dios es más grande que cualquier ser humano.
es.R: Pero te digo que en esto estás equivocado, \q porque Dios es más grande que cualquier ser humano.

fr.L: Voici, [en] cela tu n’as pas raison, je te réponds, \q car Dieu est plus grand qu’un mortel.
fr.B: Mais en cela tu n’es pas dans ton droit, je te le dis, \q car Dieu est plus grand que tout être humain.
fr.R: Mais je te le dis, sur ce point tu te trompes, \q car Dieu est plus grand que n’importe quel être humain.

sw.L: Tazama, [katika] hili hu mwenye haki, nitakujibu, \q kwa maana Mungu ni mkuu kuliko mwanadamu.
sw.B: Lakini katika hili huko sahihi, nakuambia, \q kwa maana Mungu ni mkuu kuliko mwanadamu yeyote.
sw.R: Lakini nakuambia, umekosea katika jambo hili, \q kwa sababu Mungu ni mkuu kuliko binadamu yeyote.

vi.L: Kìa, [trong] điều này ông không đúng, tôi sẽ trả lời ông, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời lớn hơn loài người phàm.
vi.B: Nhưng trong điều này ông không đúng, tôi nói cho ông biết, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời lớn hơn mọi người phàm.
vi.R: Nhưng tôi nói cho ông biết, ông đã sai về điều này, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời lớn hơn bất cứ con người nào.

ko.L: 보시오, 이 [일에서] 그대는 옳지 않소. 내가 그대에게 대답하겠소. \q 하나님은 사람보다 크시기 때문이오.
ko.B: 그러나 이 일에서는 그대가 옳지 않다고 내가 말하오. \q 하나님은 어떤 사람보다도 크시기 때문이오.
ko.R: 그러나 내가 말하건대, 이 일에서는 그대가 틀렸소. \q 하나님은 그 어떤 사람보다 크신 분이기 때문이오.

decisions.choice: you are not right: you are not in the right in this
decisions.reason: The verb (tsadaq) is the court word Job used of himself (9:2; 13:18): to be in the right. Elihu does not say that Job is wicked, but that he is wrong in this charge against God.

decisions.choice: God is greater than a mortal: God is not to be judged by human measure
decisions.reason: Elihu's first answer is that God's greatness puts him beyond a human's charges. He goes on to say that God does speak to humans, though they may not notice (verses 13-30).

decisions.choice: But (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Look" here turns to Elihu's reply; Balanced and Readable say "But".

source.text: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל־דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א־יַעֲנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Why against him have you contended, that all his words not he answers?

en.L: Why do you contend against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q [saying] that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does not answer any of his words?
en.B: Why do you complain against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answers none of a person's words?
en.R: Why do you argue with God, \q saying that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} never answers anyone?

es.L: ¿Por qué contiendes contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q [diciendo] que no responde a ninguna de sus palabras?
es.B: ¿Por qué te quejas contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q de que no responde a nada de lo que dice una persona?
es.R: ¿Por qué discutes con Dios \q diciendo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nunca responde a nadie?

fr.L: Pourquoi plaides-tu contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q [disant] qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne répond à aucune de ses paroles ?
fr.B: Pourquoi te plains-tu de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q disant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne répond à aucune des paroles d’un être humain ?
fr.R: Pourquoi discutes-tu avec Dieu \q en disant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne répond jamais à personne ?

sw.L: Mbona unashindana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, \q [ukisema] kwamba hajibu lolote kati ya maneno yake?
sw.B: Kwa nini unalalamika dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q kwamba hajibu neno lolote la mwanadamu?
sw.R: Kwa nini unabishana na Mungu, \q ukisema kwamba hamjibu mtu yeyote?

vi.L: Sao ông tranh tụng với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q [nói] rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không đáp một lời nào của người ấy?
vi.B: Sao ông than phiền chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẳng đáp lại lời nào của con người?
vi.R: Sao ông lại tranh cãi với Đức Chúa Trời, \q nói rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bao giờ trả lời ai cả?

ko.L: 어찌하여 그대는 그분과 다투며 \q 그분이 사람의 말에 하나도 대답하지 않으신다고 [하오]?
ko.B: 어찌하여 그대는 그분께서 사람의 말에 \q 아무 대답도 하지 않으신다고 그분을 원망하오?
ko.R: 어찌하여 그대는 하나님과 다투며 \q 그분이 아무에게도 대답하지 않으신다고 말하오?

decisions.choice: his words: a person's words, which God does not answer
alternatives: he gives no account of any of his own words or deeds
decisions.reason: "His" can refer to a human: Job complained that God would not answer him (19:7; 30:20; 31:35), and verses 14-30 reply that God does speak. Or it can refer to God: he gives no account of what he does. The first fits Elihu's answer better.

decisions.choice: contend: bring a case, quarrel
decisions.reason: The verb (riv) is used of a lawsuit (9:3; 10:2; 23:6). Job had wanted to take God to court.

decisions.choice: God (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names God where the Hebrew has "him".

source.text: כִּֽי־בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר־אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: For in one God speaks, and in two not one perceives it.

en.L: For God speaks in one [way], \q and in two, [yet one] does not perceive it.
en.B: For God speaks in one way, and in another, \q though people do not notice it.
en.R: God speaks again and again in different ways, \q but people do not notice.

es.L: Porque Dios habla de una [manera], \q y de dos, [pero uno] no lo percibe.
es.B: Porque Dios habla de una manera y de otra, \q aunque la gente no lo advierte.
es.R: Dios habla una y otra vez, de distintas maneras, \q pero la gente no se da cuenta.

fr.L: Car Dieu parle d’une [façon], \q et de deux, [mais on] ne le perçoit pas.
fr.B: Car Dieu parle d’une façon, puis d’une autre, \q mais on n’y prend pas garde.
fr.R: Dieu parle encore et encore, de diverses manières, \q mais les gens ne le remarquent pas.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mungu hunena kwa [njia] moja, \q na kwa mbili, [ila mtu] hatambui.
sw.B: Kwa maana Mungu hunena kwa njia moja, na kwa nyingine, \q ingawa watu hawatambui.
sw.R: Mungu husema tena na tena kwa njia mbalimbali, \q lakini watu hawatambui.

vi.L: Vì Đức Chúa Trời phán theo một [cách], \q và theo hai [cách], [nhưng người ta] không nhận ra.
vi.B: Vì Đức Chúa Trời phán cách này, rồi cách khác, \q dù người ta chẳng để ý.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời phán nhiều lần, bằng nhiều cách khác nhau, \q nhưng người ta không để ý.

ko.L: 하나님은 한 [가지로] 말씀하시고 \q 두 [가지로도 말씀하시나, 사람은] 그것을 깨닫지 못한다.
ko.B: 하나님은 이렇게도 말씀하시고 저렇게도 말씀하시지만, \q 사람들은 그것을 알아차리지 못한다.
ko.R: 하나님은 여러 방법으로 거듭 말씀하시지만, \q 사람들은 알아차리지 못한다.

decisions.choice: in one, and in two: more than once, in more than one way
decisions.reason: The pattern "one ... two" means repeatedly or in more than one way (40:5; Psalm 62:12). Elihu goes on to name two ways God speaks: dreams (verses 15-18) and suffering (verses 19-28).

decisions.choice: one does not perceive it: people fail to notice
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; it means people in general. God speaks, but people do not take it in.

source.text: בַּחֲל֤וֹם׀חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: In a dream, a vision of [the] night, when falls deep sleep on men, in slumbers on [the] bed,

en.L: In a dream, a vision of [the] night, \q when deep sleep falls on people, \q in slumbers on [the] bed,
en.B: In a dream, a vision in the night, \q when deep sleep falls on people \q as they slumber on their beds,
en.R: God speaks in dreams and visions at night, \q when people are sound asleep in their beds.

es.L: En sueño, en visión de [la] noche, \q cuando cae el sopor sobre la gente, \q mientras dormitan sobre [el] lecho,
es.B: En un sueño, en una visión nocturna, \q cuando un sueño profundo cae sobre la gente \q mientras dormitan en su cama,
es.R: Dios habla en sueños y visiones de noche, \q cuando la gente duerme profundamente en su cama.

fr.L: Dans un songe, une vision de [la] nuit, \q quand un profond sommeil tombe sur les gens, \q dans les assoupissements sur [la] couche,
fr.B: Dans un songe, une vision de la nuit, \q quand un profond sommeil tombe sur les humains \q tandis qu’ils sommeillent sur leur lit,
fr.R: Dieu parle par des songes et des visions la nuit, \q quand les gens dorment profondément dans leur lit.

sw.L: Katika ndoto, maono ya usiku, \q usingizi mzito unapowaangukia watu, \q katika usingizi kitandani,
sw.B: Katika ndoto, katika maono ya usiku, \q usingizi mzito unapowashukia watu \q wanaposinzia vitandani mwao,
sw.R: Mungu husema kwa ndoto na maono usiku, \q watu wanapolala usingizi mzito vitandani mwao.

vi.L: [Ngài phán] trong giấc mơ, trong khải tượng ban đêm, \q khi giấc ngủ say ập xuống trên người ta, \q lúc họ thiu thiu trên giường.
vi.B: Ngài phán trong giấc mơ, trong khải tượng ban đêm, \q khi người ta chìm trong giấc ngủ say \q lúc đang thiếp đi trên giường.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời phán qua giấc mơ và khải tượng ban đêm, \q khi người ta đang ngủ say trên giường.

ko.L: 꿈으로, 밤의 환상으로 [말씀하신다]. \q 깊은 잠이 사람들에게 내리고 \q 침상에서 졸고 있을 때다.
ko.B: 꿈으로, 밤의 환상으로 말씀하신다. \q 사람들이 깊은 잠에 빠져 \q 침상에서 잠들어 있을 때다.
ko.R: 사람들이 잠자리에서 깊이 잠들었을 때, \q 하나님은 밤에 꿈과 환상으로 말씀하신다.

decisions.choice: a vision of the night, deep sleep: words Eliphaz used
decisions.reason: Eliphaz described his night vision with the same words: "in visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on people" (4:13). Job too spoke of frightening dreams and visions (7:14).

decisions.choice: deep sleep: heavy, unnatural sleep
decisions.reason: The word (tardemah) is the deep sleep God brought on Adam (Genesis 2:21) and on Abraham (Genesis 15:12).

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into verse 16
decisions.reason: Verse 15 sets the scene; verse 16 says what God does then.

decisions.choice: God speaks (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable makes verse 15 a sentence of its own, supplying the subject and verb from verse 14.

decisions.choice: verses 15-18 each close as a sentence, with "[Ngài phán]" (Literal), "Ngài phán" (Balanced) opening verse 15
alternatives: one sentence running from verse 15 to 18, as the English Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Vietnamese closes each verse as its own sentence where the Hebrew runs across verses; verse 15 takes its verb from verse 14 (God speaks), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: verses 15-18 each close as a sentence; verse 15 "꿈으로, 밤의 환상으로 [말씀하신다]" and "... 때다"
alternatives: one sentence from verse 15 to 18, with the verb at the end of verse 18
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb last, so a sentence running over four verses would leave verses 15-17 without one; each verse closes as its own sentence, verse 15 taking its verb from verse 14.

source.text: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Then he uncovers [the] ear of men, and with their discipline he seals.

en.L: then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} uncovers the ear of people, \q and seals [them] with their instruction,
en.B: then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} opens people's ears \q and seals {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} warning upon them,
en.R: God opens their ears \q and seals {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} warning in their minds.

es.L: entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} destapa el oído de la gente \q y sella [en ellos] su instrucción,
es.B: entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les abre los oídos \q y sella en ellos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} advertencia,
es.R: Dios les abre los oídos \q y graba {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} advertencia en su mente.

fr.L: alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} découvre l’oreille des gens \q et [les] scelle de leur instruction,
fr.B: alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ouvre l’oreille des humains \q et scelle sur eux {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} avertissement,
fr.R: Dieu leur ouvre les oreilles \q et grave {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} avertissement dans leur esprit.

sw.L: ndipo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hufunua masikio ya watu, \q na kuwatia muhuri kwa mafundisho yao,
sw.B: ndipo huyafungua masikio ya watu \q na kutia muhuri onyo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} juu yao,
sw.R: Mungu huyafungua masikio yao \q na kulitia onyo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} mioyoni mwao.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở tai người ta, \q và đóng ấn [họ] bằng sự sửa dạy của họ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở tai người ta \q và đóng ấn lời cảnh cáo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên họ.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời mở tai họ \q và khắc ghi lời cảnh cáo của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào lòng họ.

ko.L: 그때에 그분이 사람들의 귀를 여시고 \q 그들의 훈계로 [그들을] 인 치신다.
ko.B: 그때에 그분은 사람들의 귀를 여시고 \q 그분의 경고를 그들에게 인 치신다.
ko.R: 하나님은 그들의 귀를 여시고 \q 그분의 경고를 그들의 마음에 새겨 주신다.

decisions.choice: uncover the ear: reveal something to someone
decisions.reason: To uncover someone's ear is to tell them something, often a secret (1 Samuel 9:15; 20:2; 2 Samuel 7:27). Elihu uses the phrase again in 36:10, 15.

decisions.choice: seals their instruction: stamps the warning firmly on them
decisions.reason: The word (musar) is discipline or instruction that corrects. To seal it is to make it firm and lasting, as a seal marks a document. The ancient Greek translation read a similar-looking verb, "he terrifies them" with visions, as in 7:14.

decisions.choice: his warning (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The instruction is God's, given to them; Balanced and Readable say "his warning", which is what the correction is in verses 17-18.

source.text: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: To turn aside a human [from his] deed, and pride from a man he covers.

en.L: to turn a human aside [from his] deed, \q and to cover pride from a man.
en.B: to turn people away from what they are doing \q and keep them from pride.
en.R: He does this to turn people away from doing wrong \q and to keep them from becoming proud.

es.L: para apartar al ser humano de [su] obra \q y para encubrir el orgullo al hombre.
es.B: para apartar a la gente de lo que está haciendo \q y librarla del orgullo.
es.R: Lo hace para apartar a la gente del mal \q y para que no se vuelva orgullosa.

fr.L: pour détourner l’être humain [de son] œuvre \q et cacher l’orgueil à l’homme.
fr.B: pour détourner les humains de ce qu’ils font \q et les préserver de l’orgueil.
fr.R: Il le fait pour détourner les gens du mal \q et les empêcher de devenir orgueilleux.

sw.L: ili kumgeuza mwanadamu [aache] tendo [lake], \q na kumfichia mtu kiburi.
sw.B: ili kuwageuza watu kutoka katika yale wanayoyafanya \q na kuwaepusha na kiburi.
sw.R: Hufanya hivyo ili kuwageuza watu wasitende mabaya \q na kuwazuia wasiwe na kiburi.

vi.L: [Ấy là] để khiến con người quay khỏi việc [mình] làm, \q và che giấu sự kiêu ngạo khỏi người ấy.
vi.B: Ngài làm vậy để khiến người ta quay khỏi việc họ đang làm \q và giữ họ khỏi kiêu ngạo.
vi.R: Ngài làm vậy để người ta quay khỏi điều sai trái \q và không trở nên kiêu ngạo.

ko.L: [이는] 사람을 [그의] 행위에서 돌이키시고 \q 사람에게서 교만을 덮으시려는 것이다.
ko.B: 이는 사람들이 하던 일에서 돌아서게 하시고 \q 교만에 빠지지 않게 하시려는 것이다.
ko.R: 그분이 이렇게 하시는 것은 사람들이 잘못된 일에서 돌아서고 \q 교만해지지 않게 하시려는 것이다.

decisions.choice: to turn aside: the purpose of God's warnings
decisions.reason: Verses 17-18 say why God speaks in the night: to turn a person away from a wrong course before it is too late. The warning is an act of mercy.

decisions.choice: deed: here a wrong course of action
decisions.reason: The word (ma'aseh) simply means a deed or work; the context shows it is a deed that leads to death (verse 18).

decisions.choice: cover pride from a man: put pride out of his reach, hide it from him
decisions.reason: The verb (kasah) means to cover or hide. God conceals pride from the person, keeping him from it. Some suggest the verb should be read with a similar one meaning "cut off"; the sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: generic person: Literal keeps the singular "he"; Balanced and Readable say "they"
decisions.reason: Elihu describes any human being whom God warns (verse 14), using masculine singular words as Hebrew does for anyone. Literal keeps the singular; Balanced and Readable use "people" and "they" through verses 17-30, which also keeps the person apart from God, who is "he".

decisions.choice: the person God warns is "con người", "người ấy", "người" (Literal) and "người ta", "họ" (Balanced, Readable)
alternatives: "hắn", as for the wicked in the friends' speeches
decisions.reason: Elihu speaks of any human being whom God corrects, not of a wicked man, so the neutral "người" is used rather than the scornful "hắn"; Literal keeps the singular, the other levels the plural, as the English.

decisions.choice: "사람", "그" (Literal), "사람들", "그들" (Balanced, Readable) for the person God warns
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew singular, the other levels the generic plural, as the English; God stays "그분" with -시-, so the two are never confused.

source.text: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃

records.literal_gloss: He keeps back his soul from [the] pit, and his life from passing over by [the] weapon.

en.L: He keeps back his soul from [the] pit, \q and his life from passing over by [the] weapon.
en.B: He spares them from the pit, \q their life from perishing by the sword.
en.R: He saves them from the grave \q and keeps them from dying a violent death.

es.L: Retiene su alma de [la] fosa, \q y su vida de pasar por [el] arma.
es.B: Los libra de la fosa, \q y su vida de perecer a espada.
es.R: Los salva de la tumba \q y los libra de una muerte violenta.

fr.L: Il retient son âme loin de [la] fosse, \q et sa vie de passer par [l’]arme.
fr.B: Il les préserve de la fosse, \q et leur vie de périr par l’épée.
fr.R: Il les sauve de la tombe \q et les garde d’une mort violente.

sw.L: Huizuia nafsi yake isiende shimoni, \q na uhai wake usipite kwa silaha.
sw.B: Huwaepusha na shimo, \q uhai wao usiangamie kwa upanga.
sw.R: Huwaokoa kutoka kaburini \q na kuwazuia wasife kifo cha kikatili.

vi.L: Ngài giữ linh hồn người khỏi huyệt mộ, \q và mạng sống người khỏi qua đi bởi binh khí.
vi.B: Ngài cứu họ khỏi huyệt mộ, \q giữ mạng sống họ khỏi chết vì gươm.
vi.R: Ngài cứu họ khỏi nấm mồ \q và giữ họ khỏi chết thảm.

ko.L: 그분은 그의 영혼을 구덩이에서 지키시고 \q 그의 생명이 무기에 [맞아] 넘어가지 않게 하신다.
ko.B: 그분은 그들을 구덩이에서 건지시고 \q 그들의 생명이 칼에 망하지 않게 하신다.
ko.R: 그분은 그들을 무덤에서 구하시고 \q 비참하게 죽지 않게 지켜 주신다.

decisions.choice: the pit: the grave, the world of the dead
decisions.reason: The word (shachat) means a pit and, as in verses 22, 24, 28 and 30, the grave and the realm of death (17:14; Psalm 16:10). Elihu returns to it five times in this chapter.

decisions.choice: passing over by the weapon: perishing by a violent death
decisions.reason: The word (shelach) usually means a weapon, a spear or missile (2 Chronicles 23:10; Joel 2:8). Some take it here as a channel or river, the stream to be crossed into the world of the dead, which would fit the parallel "pit". Either way the line speaks of death.

decisions.choice: his soul: his life, himself
decisions.reason: The word (nefesh) means the living self, the person; it stands beside "his life" in the second line.

decisions.choice: them, their life (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "them" for "his soul" (m3) and keep the generic plural (verse 17).

source.text: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וְר֖וֹב עֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And he is rebuked with pain on his bed, and [the] multitude of his bones [is] constant.

en.L: And he is rebuked with pain on his bed, \q and the multitude of his bones [with] constant [pain].
en.B: People are also corrected by pain on their beds, \q with constant aching in all their bones.
en.R: Or God may correct people by making them sick in bed, \q with constant pain in every bone.

es.L: Y es reprendido con dolor sobre su lecho, \q y la multitud de sus huesos [con dolor] constante.
es.B: La gente también es corregida con dolor en su cama, \q con un dolor continuo en todos sus huesos.
es.R: O Dios puede corregir a la gente haciéndola enfermar en la cama, \q con un dolor constante en cada hueso.

fr.L: Et il est repris par la douleur sur sa couche, \q et la multitude de ses os [d’une douleur] constante.
fr.B: Les humains sont aussi corrigés par la douleur sur leur lit, \q avec une souffrance continuelle dans tous leurs os.
fr.R: Ou bien Dieu peut corriger les gens en les rendant malades au lit, \q avec une douleur constante dans chaque os.

sw.L: Tena hurudiwa kwa maumivu kitandani pake, \q na wingi wa mifupa yake [kwa maumivu] ya daima.
sw.B: Watu pia hurudiwa kwa maumivu vitandani mwao, \q kwa maumivu yasiyokoma katika mifupa yao yote.
sw.R: Au Mungu anaweza kuwarudi watu kwa kuwafanya waugue kitandani, \q wakiwa na maumivu ya daima katika kila mfupa.

vi.L: Người cũng bị quở trách bằng cơn đau trên giường mình, \q và vô số xương cốt người [đau đớn] không dứt.
vi.B: Người ta cũng bị sửa phạt bằng đau đớn trên giường bệnh, \q xương cốt đau nhức không ngừng.
vi.R: Hoặc Đức Chúa Trời có thể sửa dạy người ta bằng bệnh tật nằm liệt giường, \q với nỗi đau không dứt trong từng khúc xương.

ko.L: 그는 또 침상에서 고통으로 책망을 받으니, \q 그의 수많은 뼈가 끊임없이 [아프다].
ko.B: 사람들은 또 침상에서 고통으로 징계를 받아 \q 온 뼈가 끊임없이 쑤신다.
ko.R: 하나님은 사람들을 병들어 눕게 하셔서 바로잡으시기도 한다. \q 그러면 뼈마디마다 쉴 새 없이 아프다.

decisions.choice: and he is rebuked: the second way God speaks
decisions.reason: Having described warnings in dreams (verses 15-18), Elihu turns to the second way God speaks: through illness and pain (verses 19-28).

decisions.choice: rebuked: corrected, disciplined
decisions.reason: The verb (yakach) is the one Elihu used for refuting in 32:12. Here God corrects a person through suffering, as in 5:17 and Proverbs 3:11-12.

decisions.choice: the multitude of his bones (read), not "strife in his bones" (written)
alternatives: and the strife in his bones is constant
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) give "strife" (riv): "constant strife in his bones". The scribes marked the word to be read as "multitude" (rov): all his many bones are in constant pain. The word data follows the reading, and so does this translation. The sense is much the same: the pain fills the whole body without rest.

decisions.choice: constant [pain]
decisions.reason: The line has no word for pain; it is understood from the first line. Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: God may correct (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable turns the passive into an active sentence and names God as the one who corrects (m2).

source.text: וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And makes loathsome it his life, bread, and his soul food of desire.

en.L: And his life loathes bread, \q and his soul desirable food.
en.B: They come to loathe food, \q even the food they most enjoy.
en.R: They lose their appetite \q and cannot stand even their favorite food.

es.L: Y su vida aborrece el pan, \q y su alma la comida deseable.
es.B: Llegan a aborrecer la comida, \q aun la que más les gusta.
es.R: Pierden el apetito \q y no soportan ni su comida favorita.

fr.L: Et sa vie a le pain en dégoût, \q et son âme la nourriture désirable.
fr.B: Ils en viennent à détester la nourriture, \q même celle qu’ils aiment le plus.
fr.R: Ils perdent l’appétit \q et ne supportent même plus leur plat préféré.

sw.L: Na uhai wake huchukia mkate, \q na nafsi yake chakula kitamanikacho.
sw.B: Huchukizwa na chakula, \q hata kile wanachokipenda zaidi.
sw.R: Hupoteza hamu ya kula \q na hawawezi kuvumilia hata chakula wanachokipenda sana.

vi.L: Và sự sống người gớm ghê bánh, \q và linh hồn người [gớm ghê] món ăn ngon.
vi.B: Họ đâm ra chán ghét thức ăn, \q dù là món họ thích nhất.
vi.R: Họ ăn không thấy ngon \q và không chịu nổi ngay cả món mình thích.

ko.L: 그의 생명이 빵을 싫어하고 \q 그의 영혼이 맛있는 음식을 [싫어한다].
ko.B: 사람들은 음식을 싫어하게 되고, \q 가장 좋아하던 음식마저 꺼리게 된다.
ko.R: 입맛을 잃어서 \q 가장 좋아하던 음식조차 견디지 못한다.

decisions.choice: his life, his soul: he himself, as one who hungers
decisions.reason: Both words (chayyah and nefesh) mean the living self; nefesh is often the seat of appetite (Psalm 107:18, "their soul loathed all food"). The sick man has no desire to eat.

decisions.choice: loathes: finds it disgusting
decisions.reason: The verb (zaham) is found only here; it means to make or find something loathsome.

decisions.choice: food; the food they most enjoy (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Bread" stands for food in general; Balanced and Readable say "food".

source.text: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי וְשֻׁפּ֥וּ עַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Wastes away his flesh from sight, and are laid bare his bones [which] not were seen.

en.L: His flesh wastes away from sight, \q and his bones, [which] were not seen, are laid bare.
en.B: Their flesh wastes away until it can hardly be seen, \q and their bones, once hidden, stick out.
en.R: They get so thin that their flesh almost disappears, \q and bones that were once hidden now stick out.

es.L: Su carne se consume de la vista, \q y sus huesos, [que] no se veían, quedan al descubierto.
es.B: Su carne se consume hasta casi no verse, \q y sus huesos, antes ocultos, sobresalen.
es.R: Adelgazan tanto que su carne casi desaparece, \q y los huesos que antes no se veían ahora sobresalen.

fr.L: Sa chair se consume à la vue, \q et ses os, [qui] ne se voyaient pas, sont mis à nu.
fr.B: Leur chair dépérit jusqu’à ne plus guère se voir, \q et leurs os, autrefois cachés, saillent.
fr.R: Ils maigrissent tellement que leur chair disparaît presque, \q et les os qu’on ne voyait pas ressortent maintenant.

sw.L: Nyama yake hukonda isionekane, \q na mifupa yake, [ambayo] haikuonekana, huwa wazi.
sw.B: Nyama yao hunyauka hata isionekane, \q na mifupa yao, iliyokuwa imefichika, hujitokeza.
sw.R: Hukonda sana hata nyama yao karibu itoweke, \q na mifupa iliyokuwa haionekani sasa inatokeza.

vi.L: Thịt người hao mòn khỏi tầm mắt, \q và xương người, [vốn] không thấy được, bị lộ ra.
vi.B: Thịt họ hao mòn đến mức hầu như không còn thấy, \q và xương họ, trước kia bị che khuất, nay lồi ra.
vi.R: Họ gầy đến nỗi thịt gần như biến mất, \q và xương trước kia không thấy nay lòi ra.

ko.L: 그의 살이 쇠약하여 보이지 않게 되고, \q 보이지 않던 그의 뼈가 드러난다.
ko.B: 그들의 살은 말라서 거의 보이지 않게 되고, \q 감추어져 있던 뼈가 불거져 나온다.
ko.R: 너무 말라서 살이 거의 없어지고, \q 전에는 보이지 않던 뼈가 이제는 툭 튀어나온다.

decisions.choice: wastes away from sight: grows so thin it is no longer seen
decisions.reason: The flesh shrinks until little of it is left to see, while the bones, once covered, show through the skin (19:20; Psalm 102:6).

decisions.choice: are laid bare (read)
decisions.reason: The written consonants and the reading the scribes marked differ by one letter; the reading, which the word data follows, gives "are laid bare". The sense is the same.

source.text: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And draws near to the pit his soul, and his life to those who bring death.

en.L: And his soul draws near to the pit, \q and his life to those who bring death.
en.B: They draw near to the pit, \q their life to those who bring death.
en.R: They come close to the grave, \q close to those who bring death.

es.L: Y su alma se acerca a la fosa, \q y su vida a los que traen la muerte.
es.B: Se acercan a la fosa, \q y su vida, a los que traen la muerte.
es.R: Llegan cerca de la tumba, \q cerca de los que traen la muerte.

fr.L: Et son âme s’approche de la fosse, \q et sa vie de ceux qui donnent la mort.
fr.B: Ils s’approchent de la fosse, \q leur vie, de ceux qui apportent la mort.
fr.R: Ils arrivent près de la tombe, \q près de ceux qui donnent la mort.

sw.L: Na nafsi yake hukaribia shimo, \q na uhai wake kwa wale waletao mauti.
sw.B: Hukaribia shimo, \q uhai wao kwa wale waletao mauti.
sw.R: Hukaribia kaburi, \q karibu na wale waletao kifo.

vi.L: Và linh hồn người đến gần huyệt mộ, \q và mạng sống người [đến gần] những kẻ đem sự chết.
vi.B: Họ đến gần huyệt mộ, \q mạng sống họ kề bên những kẻ đem sự chết.
vi.R: Họ gần kề nấm mồ, \q gần những kẻ đem sự chết đến.

ko.L: 그의 영혼은 구덩이에 가까워지고 \q 그의 생명은 죽음을 가져오는 자들에게 [가까워진다].
ko.B: 그들은 구덩이에 가까워지고, \q 그들의 생명은 죽음을 가져오는 자들에게 다가간다.
ko.R: 그들은 무덤 가까이 이르고, \q 죽음을 가져오는 자들 곁에 이른다.

decisions.choice: those who bring death: the destroyers, perhaps angels of death
decisions.reason: The word is a participle, "those who cause death". It may mean destroying angels such as the one sent against Jerusalem (2 Samuel 24:16) or the destroyer of Exodus 12:23; they stand in contrast to the angel who rescues in verse 23. By a small change in the vowels some read "to the dead".

decisions.choice: they, their life (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 18, "his soul" is the person himself; Balanced and Readable keep the generic plural.

decisions.choice: "la fosa" (Literal, Balanced), "la tumba" (Readable) for the pit, through this chapter
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 16:10, "la fosa" keeps the picture of the pit that stands for the grave and death; Readable says "la tumba", as the English says "the grave".

source.text: אִם־יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו׀מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי־אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: If there is for him an angel, a mediator, one from a thousand, to declare to a human his uprightness,

en.L: If there is an angel for him, \q a mediator, one out of a thousand, \q to declare to a human his uprightness,
en.B: If there is an angel beside them, \q a mediator, one out of a thousand, \q to tell them what is right for them,
en.R: But an angel may be there to help them, \q a go-between, one out of a thousand, \q to show them the right way to live.

es.L: Si hay para él un ángel, \q un mediador, uno entre mil, \q que declare al hombre su rectitud,
es.B: Si hay a su lado un ángel, \q un mediador, uno entre mil, \q que les muestre lo que es recto para ellos,
es.R: Pero puede haber un ángel que los ayude, \q un intermediario, uno entre mil, \q que les muestre el camino recto para vivir.

fr.L: S’il y a pour lui un ange, \q un médiateur, un entre mille, \q pour déclarer à l’être humain sa droiture,
fr.B: S’il y a auprès d’eux un ange, \q un médiateur, un entre mille, \q pour leur montrer ce qui est droit pour eux,
fr.R: Mais un ange peut être là pour les aider, \q un intermédiaire, un sur mille, \q pour leur montrer comment vivre droitement.

sw.L: Ikiwa yuko malaika kwa ajili yake, \q mpatanishi, mmoja kati ya elfu, \q wa kumjulisha mwanadamu unyofu wake,
sw.B: Ikiwa yuko malaika kando yao, \q mpatanishi, mmoja kati ya elfu, \q wa kuwaambia lililo sawa kwao,
sw.R: Lakini huenda malaika akawepo kuwasaidia, \q mjumbe wa kati, mmoja kati ya elfu, \q kuwaonyesha njia sahihi ya kuishi.

vi.L: Giả sử có một thiên sứ cho người, \q một đấng trung gian, một trong ngàn, \q để tỏ cho con người sự ngay thẳng của mình.
vi.B: Giả sử có một thiên sứ ở bên họ, \q một đấng trung gian, một trong ngàn, \q để chỉ cho họ điều ngay thẳng phải làm.
vi.R: Nhưng có thể có một thiên sứ ở đó giúp họ, \q một đấng trung gian, một trong ngàn, \q để chỉ cho họ con đường ngay thẳng.

ko.L: 만일 그를 위하여 천사가 있어 \q 천 가운데 하나인 중재자가 \q 사람에게 그의 정직함을 알려 준다고 하자.
ko.B: 그들 곁에 천사가 있어서 \q 천 가운데 하나인 중재자가 \q 그들에게 무엇이 옳은지 알려 준다고 하자.
ko.R: 그러나 천사가 곁에서 그들을 도울 수도 있다. \q 천 명 가운데 하나인 중재자가 \q 그들에게 바르게 사는 길을 보여 줄 수 있다.

decisions.choice: an angel: a heavenly messenger
decisions.reason: The word (mal'akh) means a messenger, human or heavenly. Set against "those who bring death" (verse 22) and pleading for a ransom (verse 24), this one is most likely a heavenly being. Eliphaz had asked to which of the holy ones Job would turn (5:1).

decisions.choice: a mediator: one who speaks between two parties
decisions.reason: The word (melits) is used of an interpreter (Genesis 42:23) and of envoys (2 Chronicles 32:31). Here it is one who speaks for a person before God. Job had longed for an arbiter between himself and God (9:33) and a witness in heaven (16:19-21). "One out of a thousand" means a rare one, one among many angels.

decisions.choice: his uprightness: what is right for him to do
decisions.reason: "His uprightness" most likely means the upright way the person should take: the angel shows him his duty, so that he turns back to God. Some take it as the person's uprightness, which the angel vouches for, or as God's uprightness.

decisions.choice: generic person: Literal keeps the singular "he"; Balanced and Readable say "they"
decisions.reason: Elihu describes any human being whom God warns (verse 14), using masculine singular words as Hebrew does for anyone. Literal keeps the singular; Balanced and Readable use "people" and "they" through verses 17-30, which also keeps the person apart from God, who is "he".

decisions.choice: But an angel may be there; a go-between (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable turns the condition into a statement of what may happen, and uses a plain word for mediator.

decisions.choice: "Giả sử có ...", closed as a sentence, with verse 24 opening "[Thì] Đấng ấy" / "Bấy giờ Đấng ấy"
decisions.reason: Each verse closes as its own sentence in Vietnamese; "giả sử" (suppose) keeps the condition while letting verse 23 stand alone.

decisions.choice: "... 알려 준다고 하자" (let us suppose), closing verse 23
decisions.reason: Korean closes each verse as a sentence; "-다고 하자" keeps the condition of the Hebrew "if" in a complete sentence.

source.text: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he is gracious to him and says, Deliver him from going down [to the] pit; I have found a ransom.

en.L: and he is gracious to him and says, \q Deliver him from going down to [the] pit; \q I have found a ransom.
en.B: and he is gracious to them and says, \q Spare them from going down to the pit; \q I have found a ransom.
en.R: and he shows them mercy and says, \q Save them from going down to the grave; \q I have found a ransom.

es.L: y él tiene piedad de él y dice: \q Líbralo de bajar a [la] fosa; \q he hallado un rescate.
es.B: y él se compadece de ellos y dice: \q Líbralos de bajar a la fosa; \q he encontrado un rescate.
es.R: y él les tiene compasión y dice: \q Sálvalos de bajar a la tumba; \q he encontrado un rescate.

fr.L: et il lui fait grâce et dit : \q Délivre-le de la descente dans [la] fosse ; \q j’ai trouvé une rançon.
fr.B: et il leur fait grâce et dit : \q Épargne-les, qu’ils ne descendent pas dans la fosse ; \q j’ai trouvé une rançon.
fr.R: et il a pitié d’eux et dit : \q Sauve-les, qu’ils ne descendent pas dans la tombe ; \q j’ai trouvé une rançon.

sw.L: naye humfanyia neema na kusema, \q Mwokoe asishuke [kwenda] shimoni; \q nimepata fidia.
sw.B: naye huwafanyia neema na kusema, \q Waepushe wasishuke shimoni; \q nimepata fidia.
sw.R: naye huwaonea huruma na kusema, \q Waokoe wasishuke kaburini; \q nimepata fidia.

vi.L: [Thì] Đấng ấy làm ơn cho người và nói: \q Hãy giải cứu người khỏi đi xuống huyệt mộ; \q đã tìm được giá chuộc.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Đấng ấy thương xót họ và nói: \q Hãy cứu họ khỏi sa xuống huyệt mộ; \q đã tìm được giá chuộc rồi.
vi.R: Đấng ấy thương xót họ và nói: \q Hãy cứu họ khỏi xuống mồ; \q đã tìm được giá chuộc rồi.

ko.L: 그분이 그에게 은혜를 베풀어 말씀하신다. \q 그를 건져 구덩이로 내려가지 않게 하여라. \q 내가 몸값을 찾았다.
ko.B: 그분은 그들에게 은혜를 베푸시며 말씀하신다. \q 그들을 살려 구덩이로 내려가지 않게 하여라. \q 내가 몸값을 찾았다.
ko.R: 그분이 그들을 불쌍히 여기시며 말씀하신다. \q 그들을 구해서 무덤으로 내려가지 않게 하여라. \q 내가 몸값을 찾았다.

decisions.choice: he: God, or the angel
decisions.reason: The verse does not name who is gracious and who speaks. Most likely it is God, who accepts the angel's plea and orders the person spared; it may be the angel, who appeals to God with the words "deliver him". Since the text leaves it open, no level names him.

decisions.choice: a ransom: a price paid to free a life
decisions.reason: The word (kofer) is the payment that releases a life otherwise forfeit (Exodus 21:30; 30:12; Psalm 49:8). Elihu does not say what the ransom is; it may be the person's repentance (verse 27) or the angel's plea itself.

decisions.choice: deliver: rescue
decisions.reason: This verb form occurs only here. It is usually taken as a form of the verb "to redeem, ransom" (padah), which comes in verse 28, or as a word meaning "to deliver".

decisions.choice: "Đấng ấy" ... "nói", and no pronoun for the one who found the ransom
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say whether God or the angel is gracious and speaks (m1). "Đấng ấy" is used of God and of heavenly beings, and Vietnamese can leave the subject of "đã tìm được giá chuộc" unspoken, so the line stays open as the English does.

decisions.choice: "그분이 ... 말씀하신다" with honorifics
decisions.reason: Korean must choose honorifics where the Hebrew leaves the speaker open (m1). God is the most likely speaker, and 그분 with -시- can also be said of a heavenly messenger, so no name is added.

source.text: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Grows fresh his flesh more than youth; he returns to [the] days of his youthful vigor.

en.L: His flesh grows fresher than [in] youth; \q he returns to the days of his youthful vigor.
en.B: Their flesh becomes fresher than a child's; \q they return to the days of their youthful strength.
en.R: Their body becomes as fresh as a child's, \q and they are as strong as they were when they were young.

es.L: Su carne se vuelve más fresca que [en] la juventud; \q vuelve a los días de su vigor juvenil.
es.B: Su carne se vuelve más fresca que la de un niño; \q vuelven a los días de su fuerza juvenil.
es.R: Su cuerpo se vuelve tan fresco como el de un niño, \q y son tan fuertes como cuando eran jóvenes.

fr.L: Sa chair devient plus fraîche que [dans] la jeunesse ; \q il revient aux jours de sa vigueur juvénile.
fr.B: Leur chair devient plus fraîche que celle d’un enfant ; \q ils reviennent aux jours de leur force juvénile.
fr.R: Leur corps redevient frais comme celui d’un enfant, \q et ils sont aussi forts que dans leur jeunesse.

sw.L: Nyama yake hunawiri kuliko [ya] ujanani; \q hurudia siku za nguvu za ujana wake.
sw.B: Nyama yao hunawiri kuliko ya mtoto; \q hurudia siku za nguvu za ujana wao.
sw.R: Mwili wao hunawiri kama wa mtoto, \q nao huwa na nguvu kama walipokuwa vijana.

vi.L: Thịt người trở nên tươi mởn hơn [thời] niên thiếu; \q người trở lại những ngày sung sức tuổi trẻ.
vi.B: Da thịt họ trở nên tươi tốt hơn da thịt trẻ thơ; \q họ trở lại những ngày cường tráng thời trẻ.
vi.R: Thân thể họ trở nên tươi tốt như của trẻ con, \q và họ khỏe mạnh như hồi còn trẻ.

ko.L: 그의 살이 젊을 때보다 더 생기 있어지고 \q 그는 원기 왕성하던 젊은 날로 돌아간다.
ko.B: 그들의 살은 아이의 살보다 더 새로워지고, \q 그들은 젊은 날의 힘을 되찾는다.
ko.R: 그들의 몸은 아이의 몸처럼 새로워지고, \q 젊었을 때처럼 튼튼해진다.

decisions.choice: grows fresh: becomes full and healthy again
decisions.reason: The verb is found only here; from the context it means to grow fresh, soft or plump, the opposite of the wasting in verse 21.

decisions.choice: fresher than youth: like the healing of Naaman
decisions.reason: When Naaman was healed, "his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child" (2 Kings 5:14). The word for youth here (na'ar) can mean a young boy or child.

source.text: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־אֱל֨וֹהַּ׀וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: He prays to God and he accepts him, and he sees his face with a shout of joy, and he restores to a mortal his righteousness.

en.L: He prays to God, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} accepts him; \q and he sees {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face with a shout of joy, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} restores to [the] mortal his righteousness.
en.B: They pray to God, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} accepts them; \q they see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face with shouts of joy, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} restores them to righteousness.
en.R: They pray to God, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is pleased with them. \q They come into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence and shout for joy, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives them back their right standing.

es.L: Ora a Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo acepta; \q y ve {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro con gritos de júbilo, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} devuelve al mortal su justicia.
es.B: Oran a Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los acepta; \q ven {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro con gritos de alegría, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los restablece en la justicia.
es.R: Oran a Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se complace en ellos. \q Llegan ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia y gritan de alegría, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les devuelve su condición de justos.

fr.L: Il prie Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’agrée ; \q et il voit {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face avec des cris de joie, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend au mortel sa justice.
fr.B: Ils prient Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les agrée ; \q ils voient {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face avec des cris de joie, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les rétablit dans la justice.
fr.R: Ils prient Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se plaît en eux. \q Ils viennent en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence en criant de joie, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur rend leur place de justes.

sw.L: Humwomba Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} humkubali; \q huuona uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa kelele za furaha, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} humrudishia mwanadamu haki yake.
sw.B: Humwomba Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huwakubali; \q huuona uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa shangwe, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huwarudisha katika haki.
sw.R: Humwomba Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} hupendezwa nao. \q Huja mbele {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} wakipiga kelele za furaha, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huwarudishia hali yao ya kuwa wenye haki.

vi.L: Người cầu nguyện với Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chấp nhận người; \q người được thấy mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tiếng reo vui, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phục hồi cho người phàm sự công chính của người.
vi.B: Họ cầu nguyện với Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chấp nhận họ; \q họ được thấy mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong tiếng reo mừng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phục hồi họ trong sự công chính.
vi.R: Họ cầu nguyện với Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hài lòng về họ. \q Họ đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và reo hò vui mừng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại xem họ là người công chính.

ko.L: 그가 하나님께 기도하면 그분이 그를 받아 주시고, \q 그는 기뻐 외치며 그분의 얼굴을 뵙는다. \q 그분은 사람에게 그의 의를 되돌려 주신다.
ko.B: 그들이 하나님께 기도하면 그분이 그들을 받아 주시니, \q 그들은 기뻐 외치며 그분의 얼굴을 뵙고, \q 그분은 그들을 다시 의롭게 세워 주신다.
ko.R: 그들이 하나님께 기도하면 그분은 그들을 기쁘게 받아 주신다. \q 그들은 그분 앞에 나아가 기뻐 소리치고, \q 그분은 그들을 다시 바른 자리에 세워 주신다.

decisions.choice: accepts: is pleased with, receives with favor
decisions.reason: The verb (ratsah) is used of God accepting a person or an offering with pleasure (Genesis 33:10; Psalm 147:11). The prayer is heard.

decisions.choice: sees his face: comes before God in worship
decisions.reason: To see God's face is to come into his presence, especially in worship at the sanctuary (Psalm 17:15; 42:3). The restored person sees God's face, not with dread but with shouts of joy, the cry raised at festivals (Psalm 27:6; 89:16).

decisions.choice: restores his righteousness: gives back his right standing with God
alternatives: he declares to people God's righteousness
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring back or restore. God treats the person as righteous again, accepted and in the right. Some take the person as the subject: he tells others of God's righteousness, leading into his song in verse 27.

decisions.choice: generic person: Literal keeps the singular "he"; Balanced and Readable say "they"
decisions.reason: Elihu describes any human being whom God warns (verse 14), using masculine singular words as Hebrew does for anyone. Literal keeps the singular; Balanced and Readable use "people" and "they" through verses 17-30, which also keeps the person apart from God, who is "he".

source.text: יָשֹׁ֤ר׀עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא־שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: He sings before men and says, I have sinned and [the] right I have perverted, and not it was repaid to me.

en.L: He sings before people and says, \q I sinned and perverted what was right, \q and it was not repaid to me.
en.B: Then they sing before others and say, \q I sinned and twisted what was right, \q but I was not repaid as I deserved.
en.R: Then they sing in front of everyone and say, \q I sinned and did what was wrong, \q but God did not punish me as I deserved.

es.L: Canta ante la gente y dice: \q Pequé y torcí lo recto, \q y no me fue pagado.
es.B: Entonces cantan delante de otros y dicen: \q Pequé y torcí lo que era recto, \q pero no se me pagó como merecía.
es.R: Entonces cantan delante de todos y dicen: \q Pequé e hice lo malo, \q pero Dios no me castigó como yo merecía.

fr.L: Il chante devant les gens et dit : \q J’ai péché et perverti ce qui était droit, \q et cela ne m’a pas été rendu.
fr.B: Alors ils chantent devant les autres et disent : \q J’ai péché, j’ai faussé ce qui était droit, \q mais je n’ai pas reçu ce que je méritais.
fr.R: Alors ils chantent devant tout le monde et disent : \q J’ai péché, j’ai fait le mal, \q mais Dieu ne m’a pas puni comme je le méritais.

sw.L: Huimba mbele ya watu na kusema, \q Nilitenda dhambi na kupotosha yaliyo sawa, \q wala halikulipizwa kwangu.
sw.B: Kisha huimba mbele ya wengine na kusema, \q Nilitenda dhambi na kupotosha yaliyo haki, \q lakini sikulipwa kama nilivyostahili.
sw.R: Kisha huimba mbele ya kila mtu na kusema, \q Nilitenda dhambi na kufanya mabaya, \q lakini Mungu hakuniadhibu kama nilivyostahili.

vi.L: Người hát trước mặt người ta và nói: \q Tôi đã phạm tội và làm cong điều ngay thẳng, \q mà điều đó không bị báo trả cho tôi.
vi.B: Rồi họ ca hát trước mặt mọi người và nói: \q Tôi đã phạm tội và bẻ cong lẽ phải, \q nhưng tôi không bị báo trả xứng với tội mình.
vi.R: Rồi họ hát trước mặt mọi người rằng: \q Tôi đã phạm tội và làm điều sai trái, \q nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã không phạt tôi như tôi đáng bị.

ko.L: 그는 사람들 앞에서 노래하며 말한다. \q 내가 죄를 짓고 옳은 것을 굽게 하였으나 \q 그것이 내게 갚아지지 않았다.
ko.B: 그러면 그들은 다른 사람들 앞에서 노래하며 말한다. \q 내가 죄를 짓고 옳은 것을 굽게 하였으나 \q 내가 받아야 할 대로 갚음을 받지 않았다.
ko.R: 그러면 그들은 모든 사람 앞에서 이렇게 노래한다. \q 나는 죄를 짓고 잘못을 저질렀지만, \q 하나님께서는 내가 받아야 할 만큼 벌하지 않으셨다.

decisions.choice: sings: sings out before others
decisions.reason: The verb can come from a root meaning "to sing" (shir) or one meaning "to look" (shur). The rescued person's public confession and thanks (as in Psalm 22:23-26; 40:10-11) suits "sings"; the word data's gloss takes it as "looks".

decisions.choice: it was not repaid to me: I was not punished as I deserved
alternatives: it was not worth it to me
decisions.reason: The verb (shavah) means to be equal or match. The person admits that the suffering did not match the sin: God spared him what he deserved. Some take it to mean that the sin did not profit him.

decisions.choice: and says: the song is a confession
decisions.reason: Hebrew has no quotation marks; the person's words begin after "says" and, in the written text, run through verse 28 (see 28 m1).

decisions.choice: God did not punish me (Readable)
alternatives: it was not repaid to me
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who held back the punishment (m2).

source.text: פָּדָ֣ה נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּתוֹ בָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: He has redeemed his soul from passing into the pit, and his life on the light will look.

en.L: He has redeemed his soul from passing into the pit, \q and his life will look on the light.
en.B: God has redeemed them from going down to the pit, \q and they will live to see the light.
en.R: God has saved them from going down to the grave, \q and they will live and enjoy the light.

es.L: Él ha redimido su alma de pasar a la fosa, \q y su vida verá la luz.
es.B: Dios los ha redimido de bajar a la fosa, \q y vivirán para ver la luz.
es.R: Dios los ha salvado de bajar a la tumba, \q y vivirán para disfrutar de la luz.

fr.L: Il a racheté son âme du passage dans la fosse, \q et sa vie verra la lumière.
fr.B: Dieu les a rachetés de la descente dans la fosse, \q et ils vivront pour voir la lumière.
fr.R: Dieu les a sauvés de la descente dans la tombe, \q et ils vivront pour profiter de la lumière.

sw.L: Ameikomboa nafsi yake isipite kuingia shimoni, \q na uhai wake utaiona nuru.
sw.B: Mungu amewakomboa wasishuke shimoni, \q nao wataishi kuiona nuru.
sw.R: Mungu amewaokoa wasishuke kaburini, \q nao wataishi na kuifurahia nuru.

vi.L: Ngài đã chuộc linh hồn người khỏi đi vào huyệt mộ, \q và mạng sống người sẽ nhìn thấy ánh sáng.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời đã chuộc họ khỏi sa xuống huyệt mộ, \q và họ sẽ sống để thấy ánh sáng.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã cứu họ khỏi xuống mồ, \q và họ sẽ được sống và vui hưởng ánh sáng.

ko.L: 그분이 그의 영혼을 구속하여 구덩이로 넘어가지 않게 하셨으니, \q 그의 생명이 빛을 볼 것이다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 그들을 구속하셔서 구덩이로 내려가지 않게 하셨으니, \q 그들은 살아서 빛을 보게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 그들을 구해 주셔서 무덤으로 내려가지 않게 하셨으니, \q 그들은 살아서 빛을 누릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: his soul, his life (read), not "my soul, my life" (written)
alternatives: He has redeemed my soul from passing into the pit, and my life will look on the light
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) say "my soul ... my life", so the verse continues the rescued person's song: "He redeemed my soul ... and my life will see the light." The scribes marked the words to be read as "his soul ... his life", so that Elihu speaks again about the person. The word data follows the reading, and so does this translation. The meaning is the same: God has rescued the person from death.

decisions.choice: redeemed: set free by paying a price
decisions.reason: The verb (padah) is the one used for buying back a life (Exodus 13:13; Psalm 49:16). It answers the ransom of verse 24.

decisions.choice: look on the light: live
decisions.reason: To see the light is to be alive (3:16, 20; Psalm 49:20). The person who was near the pit (verse 22) will go on living.

decisions.choice: God (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who redeems, since "he" could be taken for the angel or the person.

source.text: הֶן־כָּל־אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם־גָּֽבֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, all these God does, twice, three times, with a man,

en.L: Look, all these [things] God does \q twice, three times with a man,
en.B: Look, God does all these things \q two or three times with a person,
en.R: God does all these things for people \q again and again,

es.L: Mira, todas estas [cosas] hace Dios \q dos, tres veces con el hombre,
es.B: Mira, Dios hace todas estas cosas \q dos o tres veces con una persona,
es.R: Dios hace todo esto por la gente \q una y otra vez,

fr.L: Voici, toutes ces [choses], Dieu les fait \q deux fois, trois fois avec l’homme,
fr.B: Voici, Dieu fait tout cela \q deux ou trois fois avec un être humain,
fr.R: Dieu fait tout cela pour les gens \q encore et encore,

sw.L: Tazama, Mungu hufanya [mambo] haya yote \q mara mbili, mara tatu kwa mtu,
sw.B: Tazama, Mungu hufanya mambo haya yote \q mara mbili au tatu kwa mtu,
sw.R: Mungu huwatendea watu mambo haya yote \q tena na tena,

vi.L: Kìa, mọi [điều] này Đức Chúa Trời làm \q hai lần, ba lần với con người.
vi.B: Này, Đức Chúa Trời làm mọi điều ấy \q hai ba lần với một người.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời làm mọi điều ấy cho người ta \q hết lần này đến lần khác.

ko.L: 보시오, 하나님은 이 모든 [일을] \q 사람에게 두 번, 세 번 행하신다.
ko.B: 보시오, 하나님은 이 모든 일을 \q 사람에게 두 번, 세 번 하신다.
ko.R: 하나님은 사람들을 위해 이 모든 일을 \q 거듭거듭 하신다.

decisions.choice: twice, three times: again and again
